description: This file manages Matrix thread bindings, including loading/saving binding states, creating and managing binding managers, handling binding lifecycle events, and auto-cleanup of expired bindings.

methods.name: normalizeDurationMs
methods.description: Normalizes a raw duration value to a non-negative integer, falling back to a default if invalid.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Trims and normalizes a raw string input.

methods.name: normalizeConversationId
methods.description: Normalizes a conversation ID string or returns undefined if invalid.

methods.name: resolveBindingsPath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for storing thread bindings based on parameters.

methods.name: loadBindingsFromDisk
methods.description: Loads thread binding records from a JSON file, validating and normalizing data.

methods.name: toStoredBindingsState
methods.description: Converts binding records into a stored state object, sorted by binding time.

methods.name: persistBindingsSnapshot
methods.description: Atomically writes the current bindings state to disk.

methods.name: buildMatrixBindingIntroText
methods.description: Generates an introductory message for a matrix binding session.

methods.name: sendBindingMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a Matrix room or thread, returning the message ID.

methods.name: sendFarewellMessage
methods.description: Sends a farewell message to a Matrix thread or room based on binding record.

methods.name: createMatrixThreadBindingManager
methods.description: Creates and initializes a thread binding manager, loading existing bindings, setting up auto-cleanup, and managing persistence.
